breaking.change: dump() returns a DumpResult again, never untyped JSON: `ui:layers` answers `{ kind: "layers", tick, layers }`, `ui:motion` answers `{ kind: "motion", tick, motion }`, and a registered subsystem dump (`physics`, `render`, `audio`, ...) answers `{ kind: "subsystem", name, data }` with the subsystem's report under `data` instead of its fields at the top level with `kind` set to its name. `what` takes `ui:layers` and `ui:motion` only (`ui_layers` and `ui_motion` are refused), and a subsystem dump that fails is an error naming why instead of an unknown name.
breaking.fix: Narrow the result on `kind`; read a subsystem dump's fields from `data` (`dump({ what: "physics" })` gives `{ kind: "subsystem", name: "physics", data }`); write `ui:layers` and `ui:motion` for `ui_layers` and `ui_motion`.
